Dear Students,

Greetings from International Student Affairs Office!

Please be informed that the 1st student visa issued is only valid for 12 months by the Immigration Department of Malaysia.  Unfortunately, renewal of student visa depends on the condition issued by the Immigration Department whereby the renewal of visa can fall between 3,6,9 months to 12 months. As such please be reminded that as international students it is your due responsibility to monitor your student visa expiry date.

The regulation by the Immigration Department of Malaysia is as below
1.    All visa renewal documents must be submitted to ISAO office 3 months before expiry.
2.    International Students are required to maintain 80% attendance for all subjects.
3.    International Students must maintain CGPA 2.0 and above in all semesters.

Failing to fulfill the conditions above, Immigration Department of Malaysia has the authority to reject the renewal applications and students will not be able to continue their stay in Malaysia.

According to EMGS/immigration new renewal policy, existing international student in Malaysia will NOT be allowed to renew their student pass once it has expired. You will be required to exit the country, apply as new student, obtain Visa Approval Letter (VAL) and only then allowed to enter.
This process may take at least 2 months upon your new document submission once your exit country.

Please be informed that in order to renew the student visa, the passport MUST be valid for 18 months from the expiry date.   For this moment, if your passport validity is between 2024 and 2025, please contact embassy to get your que ASAP. Please take note that it will take unusual time to secure the que due to Endemic.

This is a gentle reminder to all students WHOSE STUDENT VISA WILL EXPIRE BETWEEN NOW TILL  31/10/2024 to submit :
1.    Proceed to finance and pay international admin fee of RM2500.  
2.    The 2-document compulsory to be submitted to us for visa renewal :
a.    passport scan copy (only passport detail page, current student pass page and latest date of entry only)-can use Cam scanner app, single PDF file, shall not exceed 2 mb)
b.    renewal payment receipt RM2500 (to be paid to finance)
send to @internationaloffice@xmu.edu.my

For those who already submitted documents for visa renewal for the past 4-8 weeks /passport already with IO kindly ignore this email and don't need to resend again.


International Student Affairs Department will only collect the original passport once the renewal application has been approved. This will be notified via email. (student must be continuously follow up and ensure to submit passport 3 weeks before expiry if no email received)
 
The normal process for visa renewal is between 4 to 6 weeks but if any application which has issues that require further explanation or support, the duration will exceed. Students are advised to not plan any travel, English test or any other arrangements until visa process is complete.
International Students are free to write in for advice if there is situation which will affect the renewal process. For an example, if your renewal period is during your internship period, we can advise you submit within specific dates in order to ensure the visa process does not interrupt with your internship procedure.

Your kind cooperation in this manner is highly appreciated as we are doing our best to ensure your visa in Malaysia is secured and to avoid delay in the process. Please do not hesitate to contact our team at internationaloffice@xmu.edu.my if you require further clarification.
  

Thank You and Best Regards,
Vicky

Dear XMUM students,
 
The XMUM Student Council 2024/2025 is reaching the end of its term. We are pleased to announce that nominations are now open for the new cohort of Student Council Representatives for the upcoming academic term!
The Student Council serves as the official voice of the student body, working closely with faculty and administration to enhance the school environment and support various initiatives.
This is a fantastic opportunity to:
Represent your peers and make a real impact in school activities
Develop leadership, communication, and organisational skills
Collaborate on events, initiatives, and student-led projects

Note: Each candidate is only allowed to run for one position for the upcoming election. Above is the breakdown of the seats available. Candidates who wish to apply for Executive positions need to submit a nominator and a seconder.
 
📝 Candidate Requirements :
Election candidates must have a clear understanding of representative duties and support the Student Council.
Election candidates must be registered as full-time students in any undergraduate program defined by the Admission Office of Xiamen University Malaysia.
Students who apply for positions on the President team MUST have at least been in XMUM for one year (including if the candidate did Foundation in XMUM).
Students who apply for positions of Secretary, Treasurer, and Board of Management can be students who have enrolled at XMUM for at least 6 months (2024/09 intake and earlier).
Candidates must ensure that he/she will not have an internship in 2025 until the 2026 April Semester.
Students who are currently holding executive positions in the Student Organisation or holding more than one position in clubs or societies must declare his/her commitment. A declaration form must be signed by the candidates.
Candidates must ensure he/she will not be graduating before the term ends (2026 April Semester).
Requirement of academic excellence (CGPA: 2.80/4.00).
No Record of Disciplinary of Academic Offence.
Candidates who have applied to participate in the election must hand in a deposit fee of RM100. Those candidates who withdrew after the registration period (13 MAY 2025) will have their deposits forfeited. Those candidates who violated any of the rules and regulations will have their deposit forfeited as well.

‼ Important Infromation :
Registration Link: https://forms.office.com/r/J3uxE73dxt
Registration Deadline: 13 May 2025 (Monday), 11:59 pm
 
Candidates are requested to prepare the following documents:
Candidate Passport Size Photos
Student ID (Students who have not received their student card may screenshot or take a photo of their basic information in the “XMUM Academic Affairs Online System”)
ID (passport or MyKad) 
Latest academic result script 
Bank Transfer Receipt (RM100 Deposit)
 
For any further enquiries, do refer to the Student Council Election 2025 FAQ in the Student Council Election 2025 Information PDF. For further inquiries, you may email us at studentcouncil@xmu.edu.my or contact:
Pang Yi - (https://wa.me/60109001176).

If you're ready to be the voice of your fellow students and help shape the school community, we look forward to receiving your applications and welcoming a new generation of student leaders!
